bio/w.head: †βιόω
bio/w.html: †βιόω [βίος.] 3 sing. aor. imp. βιώτω Il. 8.429. Infin. βιῶναι Il. 10.174, Il. 15.511: Od. 14.359. 2 sing. aor. mid. ἐβιώσαο Od. 8.468. 1 To live, continue to exist: ἄλλος βιώτω Il. 8.429. Cf. Il. 10.174, Il. 15.511: Od. 14.359. 2 Trans. in aor. mid., to give life to, rescue from death: σύ μʼ ἐβιώσαο Od. 8.468.

baqu/nw.head: βαθύνω
baqu/nw.html: βαθύνω [βαθύς.] To lower the surface of Il. 23.421.

boukole/w.head: βουκολέω
boukole/w.html: βουκολέω [βουκόλος.] 2 sing. pa. iterative βουκολέεσκες Il. 21.448. 1 To feed or tend cattle: Ἀγχίσῃ βουκολέοντι Il. 5.313. Cf. Il. 14.445: Od. 10.85. 2 To feed, tend (cattle): βοῦς Il. 21.448. 3 In pass., of cattle, etc., to feed, graze Il. 20.221.

boukoli/wn.head: Βουκολίων
boukoli/wn.html: Βουκολίων (ἀμύμων). Bastard son of Laomedon and father by Abarbaree of Aesepus-2 and Pedasus-3 (twins) Il. 6.22, 23.

biba/w.head: βιβάω
biba/w.html: βιβάω [redup. fr. βα-, βαίνω.] (προ-.) = βιβάσθω.: μακρὰ βιβῶντα Il. 3.22. Cf. Il. 13.371, Il. 15.307, 686: Od. 11.539. (In all cases with βιβάντα, etc., from βίβημι. as v.l.)

briseu/s.head: Βρισεύς
briseu/s.html: Βρισεύς Father of next Il. 1.392, Il. 9.132, 274.

bore/hs.head: Βορέης
bore/hs.html: Βορέης ὁ. Genit. (besides Βορέαο) Βορέω Il. 14.395, Il. 23.692: Od. 14.533. Βορέης as spondee Il. 9.5. So Βορέῃ Il. 23.195. 1 The north wind Il. 5.524, 697, Il. 9.5, Il. 14.395, Il. 15.171, Il. 19.358, Il. 20.223, Il. 21.346, Il. 23.195, 208, 692: Od. 5.296, 328, 331, 385, Od. 9.81, Od. 10.507, Od. 14.475, 533. Joined with ἄνεμος Il. 15.26: Od. 9.67, Od. 14.253, 299, Od. 19.200. 2 The north: πρὸς Βορέαο Od. 13.110.

ba/llw.head: βάλλω
ba/llw.html: βάλλω Fut. βαλέω Il. 8.403. βαλῶ Il. 17.451. 3 sing. βαλέει Od. 10.290. Dat. sing. masc. pple. βαλέοντι Od. 11.608. Aor. ἔβαλον (βάλον), -ες Il. 1.245, 436, Il. 2.692, Il. 3.368, Il. 5.188, 574, 588, Il. 8.156, etc.: Od. 1.364, Od. 4.41, 50, 344, Od. 10.172, Od. 13.267, Od. 17.89, 483, etc. Subj. βάλω Il. 17.17, 40. 2 sing. -ῃσθα Od. 12.221. 3 sing. -ῃσι Il. 21.104, 576. -ῃ Il. 20.168, 378, Il. 23.855: Od. 2.330, Od. 5.415, Od. 17.279. 1 pl. -ωμεν Il. 4.16. Opt. βάλοιμι Il. 16.623: Od. 8.216. 2 sing. οισθα Il. 15.571. 3 sing. -οι Il. 11.389: Od. 4.223, Od. 17.251, 494, Od. 20.65, 80. Pple. βαλών, -όντος Il. 5.145, Il. 7.270, Il. 11.454, Il. 17.457, Il. 22.207, Il. 23.572, etc.: Od. 4.245, Od. 5.128, Od. 8.501, Od. 9.470, Od. 11.211, Od. 17.567, Od. 22.92, etc. Neut. βαλόν Od. 7.279. Fem. βαλοῦσα, -ης Il. 23.462: Od. 6.100, Od. 20.62. Infin. βαλέειν Il. 2.414, Il. 7.242, Il. 10.368, Il. 13.629, etc.: Od. 4.198, Od. 5.349, Od. 8.508, Od. 9.137, Od. 14.399, Od. 22.174. βαλεῖν Il. 13.387, Il. 14.424. 3 sing. plupf. (in intensive impf. or aor. sense) βεβλήκει(ν) Il. 4.108, 492, Il. 5.66, 73, 394, 661, Il. 12.401, Il. 14.412, Il. 17.606: Od. 22.258, 275, 286. 3 sing. opt. -οι Il. 8.270. Mid. Imp. βάλλευ Od. 12.218. Aor. βαλόμην Od. 10.262. 3 sing. βάλετο Il. 2.45, Il. 3.334, Il. 5.738, Il. 11.29, Il. 16.135, Il. 19.372: Od. 5.231, Od. 10.544, Od. 14.528, Od. 15.61. 3 pl. ἐβάλοντο Il. 12.377, Il. 15.566, Il. 23.352: Od. 14.209. 3 sing. subj. βάληται Od. 11.428. Pass. 3 sing. aor. ἔβλητο Il. 11.410, 675, Il. 12.306, Il. 16.753. βλῆτο Il. 4.518, Il. 16.570, Il. 17.598. 3 sing. subj. βλήεται Od. 17.472. 2 sing. opt. βλεῖο Il. 13.288. Pple. βλήμενος, -ου Il. 4.211, Il. 8.514, Il. 11.191, 206, Il. 12.391, Il. 15.495, 580, Il. 17.726, Il. 21.594: Od. 17.490, 493, Od. 22.18. Infin. βλῆσθαι Il. 4.115: Od. 22.253. 2 sing. pf. βέβληαι Il. 5.284, Il. 11.380, Il. 13.251. 3 sing. βέβληται Il. 5.103, Il. 11.660, 662, Il. 16.25, 27. 3 pl. βεβλήαται Il. 11.657: Od. 11.194. 3 sing. plupf. βέβλητο Od. 12.423. 3 pl. βεβλήατο Il. 14.28: Od. 7.97. Pple. βεβλημένος, -ου Il. 11.475, 592, 659, Il. 12.2, Il. 13.764, Il. 14.63, etc.: Od. 11.535, Od. 19.69. (ἀμφι-, ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐμ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, παρακατα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συμ-, ὑπερ-, ὑπο-.) I To throw. 1 To throw or cast in general: ποτὶ σκῆπτρον βάλε γαίῃ Il. 1.245. Cf. Il. 2.183, Il. 21.51, Il. 22.468, etc.: Od. 5.349, Od. 8.508, Od. 19.63, Od. 20.65, etc. Of winds, to beat upon so as to throw (together): πυρῆς ἄμυδις φλόγʼ ἔβαλλον Il. 23.217. 2 To throw or let fly (a missile): χαλκόν Il. 5.317 = 346: βέλος Od. 9.495. Cf. Od. 9.482, 539, Od. 20.62. Absol.: μὴ βάλλετε Il. 3.82. Cf. Il. 1.52, Il. 8.282, Il. 13.718, 721, Il. 16.104: Od. 9.158, Od. 11.608. In mid., with reciprocal force: βαλλομένων (as they threw at one another) Il. 12.289. With the missile in dat.: λάεσσιν Il. 3.80. Cf. Il. 12.155: Od. 10.122. 3 To hurl or throw (a person down): κατὰ μύνητʼ ἔβαλεν Il. 2.692. Cf. Il. 5.588, Il. 8.156: Od. 22.188. To throw in wrestling Il. 23.727: Od. 4.344 = Od. 17.135. To hurl from something: ἐκ δίφρου Il. 8.403, 417. Cf. Il. 11.109. To thrust back from something: ἀπʼ αὐτάων δηΐους Il. 12.264. To thrust or cause to go into a place: ἐς θάλαμον Od. 22.174. 4 In reference to things, to throw down, destroy: κατὰ βαλέειν μέλαθρον Il. 2.414. Cf. Il. 9.541. To send flying, cause to fall: τῆλε κάρη βάλεν Il. 20.482. To knock off from something: ἀπὸ κρατὸς κυνέην Il. 16.793. Out of something: ἐκ χειρῶν μάστιγα Il. 23.384. To thrust or cause to strike against something: πρὸς ἀλλήλας ἔβαλον ὄζους Il. 16.768. 5 To thrust or urge (one's horses in front or in advance): τοὺς σοὺς [ἵππους] πρόσθε βαλών Il. 23.572. Absol. Il. 23.639. Intrans. of horses, to thrust themselves forward, rush Il. 23.462. 6 To put (a ship to sea): νῆας ἐς πόντον βάλλουσιν Od. 4.359. 7 Of the action of the sea, to beat, drive: ποτὶ πέτρῃ κῦμα Od. 5.415. Cf. Od. 7.279, Od. 9.284, Od. 12.71. 8 To cause to be somewhere or in some position, to throw, put, place, set: σύν ῥʼ ἔβαλον ῥινούς Il. 4.447, βαλέτην ἐν χερσὶν ἑταίρων Il. 5.574. Cf. Il. 2.376, Il. 5.722, Il. 13.36, Il. 19.394, etc.: θρόνοις ἔνι ῥήγεα Od. 10.352. Cf. Od. 4.455, Od. 7.97, Od. 9.470, Od. 11.194, Od. 12.221, etc. In mid.: ἐν (ἐπὶ) κλήρους ἐβάλοντο Il. 23.352: Od. 14.209. In mid., to put oneself in act to do something: σὺν δʼ ἐβάλοντο μάχεσθαι Il. 12.377. 9 In reference to immaterial things, to send, set, inspire: ἐν στήθεσσι μένος βάλεν Il. 5.513, σὺν δʼ ἔβαλον πόλεμον (joined battle) Il. 12.181. Cf. Il. 4.16, Il. 17.451, Il. 21.547: ἐν φύζαν ἑτάροισιν Od. 14.269 = Od. 17.438. Without expressed object: ὡς ἐνὶ θυμῷ ἀθάνατοι βάλλουσιν Od. 1.201 = Od. 15.173. 10 To let fall: ποτὶ γαίῃ χεῖρας Od. 11.424. To let fall or shed (tears): δάκρυ χαμάδις βάλεν Od. 4.114. Cf. Od. 4.198, 223, Od. 17.490. Of shedding sleep: ὕπνον ἐπὶ βλεφάροισιν Od. 1.364 = Od. 16.451 = Od. 19.604 = Od. 21.358. To let hang down: ἑτέρωσε κάρη Il. 8.306, Il. 23.697. To lay on (the lash): ἐφʼ ἵπποιϊν μάστιν Od. 15.182. 11 To turn (the eyes): ἑτέρωσʼ ὄμματα Od. 16.179. 12 Of a river, to carry down with it and discharge (into the sea): ἀφυσγετὸν εἰς ἅλα Il. 11.495. Absol., to discharge its waters, empty itself: εἰς ἅλα βάλλων Il. 11.722. 13 Of throwing or putting clothes, armour, etc., on a person, enduing him with them: ἀμφί μιν φᾶρος Il. 24.588. Cf. Il. 18.204: Od. 3.467, Od. 4.50, 440, Od. 13.434, etc.– So of putting on onesef: σπεῖρʼ ἀμφʼ ὤμοισι βαλών Od. 4.245. In mid.: περὶ βάλλετο φᾶρος Il. 2.43, ἀμφʼ ὤμοισι βάλετο ξίφος 45 = Il. 3.334 = Il. 16.135 = Il. 19.372, Il. 11.29. Cf. Il. 5.738, Il. 10.333: περὶ ζώνην βάλετʼ ἰξυῖ Od. 5.231 = Od. 10.544. Cf. Od. 10.262, Od. 14.528, Od. 15.61, Od. 17.197 = Od. 18.108. 14 In mid., to lay (to heart): ἐνὶ φρεσὶ βάλλεο σῇσιν Il. 1.297 = Il. 4.39 = Il. 5.259 = Il. 9.611 = Il. 16.444 = 851 = Il. 21.94. Cf. Il. 15.566: Od. 11.454 = Od. 16.281 = 299 = Od. 17.548 = Od. 19.236 = 495 = 570, Od. 12.218. To cherish (in the heart): ἐν θυμῷ βάλλονται ἐμοὶ χόλον Il. 14.50. To think of or consider as to (in one's mind): εἰ νόστον μετὰ φρεσὶ βάλλεαι Il. 9.435. Sim.: ὡς ἐνὶ θυμῷ βάλλεαι (as thou (fondly) fanciest) Il. 20.196: ἥ τις τοιαῦτα μετὰ φρεσὶν ἔργα βάληται (conceives, contrives) Od. 11.428. II To strike. 1 a To strike or wound (a person, etc.) with a missile, and in pass., to be so struck or wounded: υἱὸν Πριάμοιο Il. 4.499, βεβλημένοι οὐτάμενοί τε Il. 11.659. Cf. Il. 8.81, Il. 12.391, Il. 15.249, etc.: ἀργῆτι κεραυνῷ Od. 5.128, ὁππότʼ ἀνὴρ βλήεται Od. 17.472. Cf. Od. 11.535, Od. 13.267, Od. 17.279, Od. 22.283, etc. b With the part of the body struck as object: αὐχένα μέσσον Il. 5.657. Cf. Il. 13.594, Il. 16.807, Il. 21.591, etc.: δεξιὸν ὦμον Od. 17.462. Cf. Od. 17.504, Od. 22.82. With the part of the armour struck as object: Αἴαντος σάκος Il. 7.245. Cf. Il. 13.258, Il. 21.164, etc. In pass.: πήληξ βαλλομένη καναχὴν ἔχε, βάλλετο δʼ αἰεί Il. 16.105. c With double acc. of the person and the part of the body struck; στῆθός μιν Il. 4.480. Cf. Il. 13.506, Il. 15.341, Il. 16.399, Il. 21.166, etc.: Od. 18.396, Od. 20.306, Od. 22.277. With acc. of the person and of the part of the armour struck; τὸν τελαμῶνα Il. 12.401, Ἕκτορα θώρηκα Il. 17.606. Cf. Il. 5.98, etc. d In pass. with acc. of the part struck: βλῆτο κνήμην Il. 4.518. Cf. Il. 5.284, Il. 17.598. e With double acc. of the person and of the wound: ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε πάνδαρος Il. 5.795. Cf. Il. 16.511. f Without object, but with words indicating where the blow falls: βάλεν Ἀτρεΐδαο κατʼ ἀσπίδα Il. 3.347. Cf. Il. 3.356, Il. 5.305, etc.– g With the missile as subject Il. 5.17 = Il. 16.479. 2 Of striking inanimate objects: βάλε μέσσας [σανίδας] Il. 12.457. Cf. Il. 9.574, Il. 21.171, Il. 23.866, etc.: νῆα κεραυνῷ Od. 12.388, Od. 23.330, ἐπίτονος βέβλητο (was snapped) Od. 12.423. Cf. Od. 20.302, Od. 22.258 = 275. 3 Of such objects striking: ἄντυγας (ἡνίοχον) ῥαθάμιγγες Il. 11.536 = Il. 20.501, Il. 23.502. Of the sun: ἀκτῖσιν ἔβαλλεν Od. 5.479, Od. 19.441. Of sound: κτύπος οὔατα βάλλει Il. 10.535. 4 In mid. with ἀνά, to strike up, being(to sing) (cf. ἀναβάλλω 2): ἀνά σφισι βάλλετʼ ἀείδειν Od. 17.262.

bali/os.head: Βαλίος
bali/os.html: Βαλίος One of the horses of Achilles, by Zephyrus out of Podarge Il. 16.149 , Il. 19.400.

bow=pis.head: βοῶπις
bow=pis.html: βοῶπις [βο-, βοῦς + ὦπα.] Ox-eyed, having large, soft eyes. Epithet of Here Il. 1.551 = Il. 4.50 = Il. 16.439 = Il. 18.360 = Il. 20.309 Il. 1.568, Il. 8.471, Il. 14.159, 222, 263, Il. 15.34, 49, Il. 18.239, 357. Of Clymene (one of Helen's handmaidens) Il. 3.144. Of Phylomedousa Il. 7.10. Of the sea-nymph Halie Il. 18.40.

baqu/zwnos.head: βαθύζωνος
baqu/zwnos.html: βαθύζωνος -ον [βαθύς + ζώνη.] Deep-girded, so girt that the upper part of the robe falls down in a deep fold (κόλπος) over the girdle. Epithet of women Il. 9.594: Od. 3.154.

bombe/w.head: βομβέω
bombe/w.html: βομβέω [imitative] To make a resounding, clanging or clashing noise Il. 13.530, Il. 16.118: Od. 12.204 (the oars knocked against each other in the wash of the sea as they hung by the τροποί), Od. 18.397. Of the whizzing flight of a quoit Od. 8.190.

brexmo/s.head: βρεχμός
brexmo/s.html: βρεχμός ὁ. App., the head: ἔπεσε ἐπὶ βρεχμόν τε καὶ ὤμους Il. 5.586.

boibhi/s.head: Βοιβηΐς
boibhi/s.html: Βοιβηΐς (λίμνη). A lake lying west of and under the range of Pelion and Ossa Il. 2.711.

baqu/sxoinos.head: βαθύσχοινος
baqu/sxoinos.html: βαθύσχοινος [βαθύς + σχοῖνος.] With banks thickly set with rushes: Ἀσωπόν Il. 4.383.

bouplh/c.head: βουπλήξ
bouplh/c.html: βουπλήξ -ῆγος, ὁ [βοῦς + πληγ-, πλήσσω.] An ox-whip or-goad; or perh., a pole-axe: θεινόμεναι βουπλῆγι Il. 6.135.

boulhfo/ros.head: βουληφόρος
boulhfo/ros.html: βουληφόρος [βουλή + -φορος, φέρω. Contributing counsel.] 1 A (trusted) adviser, a leader in counsel Il. 5.180 = Il. 17.485, Il. 5.633, Il. 7.126, Il. 10.518, Il. 13.219, 255, 463, Il. 20.83. 2 Specifically, a member of the βουλή, a leading chief Il. 10.414, Il. 24.651: Od. 13.12. Joined with ἀνήρ Il. 1.144, Il. 2.24 = 61. With ἄναξ Il. 12.414. 3 As adj.: ἀγοραὶ βουληφόροι (in which counsel is exchanged) Od. 9.112.

boh/.head: βοή
boh/.html: βοή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 A crying out, a shouting: βοῆς ἀΐοντες Od. 9.401, Od. 14.266 = Od. 17.435. A hue-and-cry, a din: διὰ ἄστεος Od. 10.118. Cf. Od. 22.77, 133. 2 A shouting in battle: Il. 11.50, 500, 530, Il. 13.169 = 540, Il. 14.4, Il. 16.267.–βοὴν ἀγαθός, good at the battle-cry, marshalling or rallying his men with loud shout. Of Menelaus Il. 2.408, 586, Il. 3.96, Il. 4.220, Il. 6.37, etc.: Od. 3.311, Od. 4.307, 609, Od. 15.14, 57, 67, 92, 97, Od. 17.120. Of Diomedes Il. 2.563, Il. 5.114, Il. 6.12, Il. 7.399, Il. 8.91, etc. Of Hector Il. 13.123, Il. 15.671. Of Aias Il. 15.249, Il. 17.102. Of Polites Il. 24.250. 3 A loud expression of grief Il. 6.465: Od. 24.48. 4 The sound of musical instruments Il. 18.495.

boufone/w.head: βουφονέω
boufone/w.html: βουφονέω [βοῦς + φον-, *φένω.] To slay an ox or oxen for sacrifice Il. 7.466.

bre/fos.head: βρέφος
bre/fos.html: βρέφος τό. Unborn offspring Il. 23.266.

bou/brwstis.head: βούβρωστις
bou/brwstis.html: βούβρωστις ἡ [app. a compound of βοῦς.] Explained as the insect that attacks cattle, the gadfly. By others connected with βι-βρώσκω and explained as ravenous hunger (taking βου- in an intensive sense. Cf. βουγάϊος) Il. 24.532.

bou=s.head: βοῦς
bou=s.html: βοῦς βοός, ὁ, ἡ (βοϝ-. Cf. L. bouis). Acc. βῶν Il. 7.238. Dat. pl. βόεσσι Il. 2.481, Il. 7.474, Il. 11.674, Il. 12.105, etc.: Od. 20.219. βουσί Il. 5.161, Il. 6.424, Il. 7.333, Il. 12.293, etc.: Od. 6.132, Od. 15.386, Od. 17.472, Od. 20.209, 221. Acc. βόας Il. 5.556, Il. 8.505, 545, Il. 12.137, etc.: Od. 11.108, 289, Od. 12.375, Od. 18.278, etc. βοῦς Il. 1.154, Il. 6.93, 174, 274, etc.: Od. 1.8, 92, Od. 2.56, Od. 8.60, etc. 1 A bull, ox, or cow. a Gender not determined: βοῦς ἱέρευσεν Il. 6.174, ἀγέλην βοῶν Il. 11.696, ἱμάντας βοός (i.e. of the hide) Il. 23.684. Cf. Il. 5.556, Il. 7.333, Il. 8.240, 505, Il. 9.466, Il. 18.528, etc.: νῶτα βοός Od. 4.65. Cf. Od. 2.56, Od. 3.421, Od. 6.132, Od. 11.402, Od. 13.32, Od. 15.386, etc. b Masculine: ἶφι κταμένοιο Il. 3.375, βόε ἶσον θυμὸν ἔχοντε Il. 13.703, ἐριμύκων Il. 20.497 (for the gender see 495). Cf. Il. 13.571, Il. 18.559, Il. 23.775, etc.: Od. 1.108, Od. 18.371. Joined with ταῦρος Il. 2.480, Il. 17.389. Qualified by ἄρσην Il. 7.314, Il. 20.495: Od. 19.420. c Feminine: ἐμὰς βοῦς Il. 1.154, αὐτῇσι βόεσσιν Il. 7.474. Cf. Il. 6.93, Il. 8.231, Il. 10.292, Il. 11.172, Il. 17.62, Il. 18.574, etc.: στεῖραν βοῦν Od. 10.522, πολλαί Od. 12.128. Cf. Od. 3.382, Od. 10.410, Od. 11.108, Od. 12.262, Od. 20.221, etc. Distinguished from ταῦρος Il. 2.481, Il. 16.488. 2 A shield of ox-hide. In this sense fem.: τυκτῇσι βόεσσιν Il. 12.105. Cf. Il. 7.238, Il. 12.137, Il. 16.636.

boa/grios.head: Βοάγριος
boa/grios.html: Βοάγριος A Locrian river Il. 2.533.

bri/zw.head: βρίζω
bri/zw.html: βρίζω (ἀπο-.) To slumber, nod Il. 4.223.

boiw/tios.head: Βοιώτιος
boiw/tios.html: Βοιώτιος Boeotian Il. 14.476 , Il. 17.597.

brishi/s.head: Βρισηΐς
brishi/s.html: Βρισηΐς (ἠΰκομος, ἰκέλη Ἀφροδίτῃ , καλλιπάρῃος). Patronymic from prec. Captured by Achilles at Lyrnessus Il. 2.689 ; Il. 1.184; taken from Achilles by Agamemnon's heralds Il. 1.323, 336, 346, Il. 9.106; restored Il. 19.246, 261 ; her lament over Patroclus Il. 19.282; Il. 24.676.

brw=sis.head: βρῶσις
brw=sis.html: βρῶσις ἡ [as βρώμη.] = βρώμη. (1) Il. 19.210: Od. 1.191, Od. 6.209 = 246, 248, Od. 10.176, Od. 12.320, Od. 13.72, Od. 15.490.

brotoloigo/s.head: βροτολοιγός
brotoloigo/s.html: βροτολοιγός [βροτός + λοιγός.] Destroyer of men. Epithet of Ares Il. 5.31 = 455, 518, 846, 909, Il. 8.349, Il. 11.295, Il. 12.130, Il. 13.298, 802, Il. 20.46, Il. 21.421: Od. 8.115.

biba/sqw.head: βιβάσθω
biba/sqw.html: βιβάσθω [βιβάω.] To stride, stride along: μακρὰ βιβάσθων Il. 13.809, Il. 15.676, Il. 16.534.

baru/qw.head: βαρύθω
baru/qw.html: βαρύθω [βαρύς.] To be weighed down: βαρύθει μοι ὦμος (has lost its power) Il. 16.519.

baqudinh/eis.head: βαθυδινήεις
baqudinh/eis.html: βαθυδινήεις -εντος [βαθύς + δίνη.] Deep-eddying: ξάνθου Il. 21.15, Σκάμανδρον 603.

bia/w.head: βιάω
bia/w.html: βιάω [βίη.] 3 sing. pf. βεβίηκε Il. 10.145, 172, Il. 16.22. 3 pl. pres. mid. βιόωνται Od. 11.503. 3 pl. impf. βιόωντο Od. 23.9. 3 pl. opt. βιῴατο Il. 11.467. 1 To use violence to, lay constraint upon. In mid.: ὃ κεῖνον βιόωνται Od. 11.503. Cf. Od. 23.9. Of something immaterial: τοῖον ἄχος βεβίηκεν Ἀχαιούς Il. 10.145 = Il. 16.22. Cf. Il. 10.172. 2 To prove too strong for, force, overcome. In mid.: ὄνος ἐβιήσατο παῖδας Il. 11.558. Cf. Il. 11.467, Il. 16.823. 3 To force to act against one's will. In mid.: οὔ τίς μʼ ἀέκοντα βιήσεται Od. 21.348. To compel in a certain direction, throw upon something: ἐκβαίνοντά κέ με βιήσατο κῦμʼ ἐπὶ χέρσου Od. 7.278. 4 To push one's advantage against, get the better of. In mid.: ψεύδεσσι βιησάμενος Il. 23.576. 5 To rob (of one's due). In mid. with double acc.: νῶϊ βιήσατο μισθόν Il. 21.451.

bo/qros.head: βόθρος
bo/qros.html: βόθρος -ου, ὁ. 1 A hole or pit dug in the ground: βόθρον ὀρύξαι Od. 10.517, ἀπεδειροτόμησα ἐς βόθρον (so that the blood ran into the pit) Od. 11.36. Cf. Od. 11.25, 42, 95. 2 A hollow by a river used for washing clothes Od. 6.92. 3 The trench in which a young tree is planted Il. 17.58.

bla/ptw.head: βλάπτω
bla/ptw.html: βλάπτω 2 sing. aor. ἔβλαψας Il. 22.15. βλάψας Il. 23.571. 3 sing. ἔβλαψε Il. 23.782. βλάψε Il. 7.271, Il. 23.774: Od. 14.178. 3 pl. ἔβλαψαν Od. 23.14. 3 pl. aor. pass. ἐβλάφθησαν Il. 23.387. Also ἔβλαβεν Il. 23.461. βλάβεν Il. 23.545. Pple. βλαφθείς, -έντος Il. 6.39, Il. 9.512, Il. 15.484, 489, 647, Il. 16.331. Acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. βεβλαμμένον Il. 16.660. 1 To cause to fail or break down, make useless: γούνατα Il. 7.271. Cf. Il. 15.484, 489. To stop, cut short the course of: ἵπποι ἔβλαβεν Il. 23.461. Cf. Il. 23.545. Sim.: βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ (app., brought to a stop in his life, slain) Il. 16.660. 2 To impede the course of: ἵππους Il. 23.571. To impede the motion of, entangle: βλαφθέντα κατὰ κλόνον Il. 16.331. To impede in action, be in the way of: ἑταίρων τίνʼ ἐλαυνόντων Od. 13.22. To entangle, catch: ἵππω ὄζῳ ἔνι βλαφθέντε Il. 6.39. Cf. Il. 15.647. 3 To trip, cause to stumble Il. 23.774. To trip up (the feet of). With double acc.: ἔβλαψέ με πόδας Il. 23.782. 4 To put at a disadvantage, [ἵπποι] ἐβλάφθησαν ἄνευ κέντροιο θέοντες Il. 23.387. 5 To hinder from. With genit.: κελεύθου Od. 1.195. 6 Of a divine agency. a To affect the mind of adversely, smite with mental blindness. Of Ἄτη Il. 9.507, 512, Il. 19.94. With φρένας as object : εἰ τότε βλάπτε φρένας Ζεύς Il. 15.724. b To deprive of good sense, put out of one's right mind: θεοί σʼ ἔβλαψαν Il. 23.14. With φρένας as second acc.: τόν τις ἀθανάτων βλάψε φρένας Od. 14.178. c To foil: ἔβλαψάς μʼ , ἑκάεργε Il. 22.15. 7 Of wine, to drive out of one's right mind Od. 21.294.

bibrw/skw.head: †βιβρώσκω
bibrw/skw.html: †βιβρώσκω 2 sing. pf. opt. βεβρώθοις Il. 4.35. Pf. pple. βεβρωκώς Il. 22.94: Od. 22.403. 3 sing. fut. pf. pass. βεβρώσεται Od. 2.203. To eat. 1 In pf. forms in intensive sense: εἰ βεβρώθοις Πρίαμον (eat up, devour) Il. 4.35. Sim. of χρήματα Od. 2.203 (will be consumed). 2 In strict pf. sense: βεβρωκὼς φάρμακα Il. 22.94. So with partitive genit.: βεβρωκὼς βοός Od. 22.403.

bellerofo/nths.head: Βελλεροφόντης
bellerofo/nths.html: Βελλεροφόντης (ἀμύμων, δαΐφρων ). Son of Glaucus-1 and father of Isandrus, Hippolochus-1 and Laodameia. His beauty and valour Il. 6.155; repulsed the love of Anteia, wife of Proetus Il. 6.160, by her contrivance sent by Proetus to Proetus's father-in-law the king of Lycia with a secret message importing his death 163, the dangerous tasks set him 178, and the ambush laid for him 187, received the king's daughter to wife and half of the kingdom 191 , his children 196, his fate 200; had been entertained by Oeneus Il. 6.216, 220.

bronta/w.head: βροντάω
bronta/w.html: βροντάω [βροντή.] Of Zeus, to thunder Il. 8.133, Il. 20.56: Od. 12.415 = Od. 14.305, Od. 20.103, 113.

be/nqos.head: βένθος
be/nqos.html: βένθος τό. 1 The depth or gulf (of the sea): κατὰ β. ἁλός Il. 18.38, 49. In pl. in sim. sense: ἐν βένθεσσιν ἁλός Il. 1.358 = Il. 18.36. Cf. Il. 13.21, 32. 2 In pl., the deeps or deep recesses (of the sea): θαλάσσης πάσης βένθεα οἶδεν Od. 1.53, Od. 4.386. The recesses or coverts (of a wood): βαθείης βένθεσιν ὕλης Od. 17.316.

blw/skw.head: †βλώσκω
blw/skw.html: †βλώσκω [μβολ-.] 3 sing. aor. subj. μόλῃ Il. 24.781. Pple. μολών, -όντος Il. 11.173: Od. 3.44, Od. 24.335. Fem. μολοῦσα, -ης Il. 6.286, Il. 15.720. 3 sing. pf. μέμβλωκε Od. 17.190. (ἐκ-, κατα-, παρα-, προ-.) 1 To go: ποτὶ μέγαρα Il. 6.286. Of a period of time, to pass away Od. 17.190. 2 To come: δεῦρο Il. 15.720. Cf. Il. 11.173.Od. 3.44, Od. 24.335. Of a period of time, to come on Il. 24.781.

boi/bh.head: Βοίβη
boi/bh.html: Βοίβη A town of the realm of Eumelus lying on the Boebean Lake (see next) Il. 2.712.

bi/otos.head: βίοτος
bi/otos.html: βίοτος -ου, ὁ [βίος.] 1 Life, existence, one's life: βιότοιο μεγήρας Il. 13.563. Cf. Il. 4.170: Od. 5.394, Od. 12.328, Od. 24.536. 2 The period of one's life: βιότοιο τελευτή Il. 7.104, Il. 16.787. 3 The fact of being alive: εἴ κεν πατρὸς βίοτον ἀκούσῃς Od. 1.287. Cf. Od. 2.218. 4 The means of living, substance, goods, chattels: ἀφνειὸς βιότοιο Il. 5.544. Cf. Il. 6.14, Il. 14.122: ἀλλότριον βίοτον ἔδουσιν Od. 1.160 Od. 18.280. Cf. Od. 1.377, Od. 2.49, 123, 126, Od. 3.301, Od. 4.90, 686, etc.

baqu/s.head: βαθύς
baqu/s.html: βαθύς -εῖα, -ύ. Fem. -έη Il. 5.142, Il. 15.606, Il. 16.766, Il. 21.213. 1 Deep: ἅλα Il. 1.532. Cf. Il. 7.341, 440, Il. 8.336, 481, Il. 13.32, Il. 15.356, etc.: Od. 6.116, Od. 12.214. Epithet of φρήν Il. 19.125. In superl. βάθιστος Il. 8.14. Where we should rather say high: αὐλῆς (high-walled) Il. 5.142: Od. 9.239, 338. Sim., app., of a storm, reaching from earth to heaven Il. 11.306. 2 Deep, extending far inwards: ἠϊόνος Il. 2.92. Deeply indenting the land: κόλπον Il. 2.560. 3 Growing thickly, affording thick covert: ὕλης Il. 5.555. Cf. Il. 11.415, Il. 15.606, Il. 16.766, Il. 20.491, Il. 21.573: Od. 17.316. 4 Lying thick: τέφρη Il. 23.251. Forming a thick deposit: ἀμάθοιο Il. 5.587. 5 With deep soil: νειοῖο Il. 10.353, Il. 18.547. 6 Forming a deep, rich crop: λήϊον Il. 2.147, Il. 11.560: Od. 9.134. 7 Thick, obstructing vision: ἠέρα Il. 20.446. Cf. Il. 21.7: Od. 9.144.

bo/trus.head: βότρυς
bo/trus.html: βότρυς -υος, ὁ. A bunch or cluster of grapes: μέλανες Il. 18.562.

broto/s.head: βροτός
broto/s.html: βροτός -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ [μ-βροτός. Cf. ἄμβροτος2.] 1 Liable to death, mortal: ἀνήρ Il. 5.361. Cf. Il. 5.604, Il. 18.85, Il. 19.22: Od. 4.397, Od. 5.129, 197, 218, Od. 12.77. 2 Absol., a mortal man, a man: θεὰ βροτῷ εὐνηθεῖσα Il. 2.821. Cf. Il. 1.272, Il. 8.428, Il. 9.159, Il. 11.2, Il. 13.244, etc.: βροτῶν θελκτήρια Od. 1.337. Cf. Od. 4.197, Od. 5.101, Od. 6.149, Od. 11.287, Od. 12.125, etc. Qualified by θνητός Od. 3.3 = Od. 12.386, Od. 7.210, Od. 16.212. For μέροπες βροτοί see μέροπες.

bou/lomai.head: βούλομαι
bou/lomai.html: βούλομαι (προ-). 1 To have a preference for one of two things, to wish, be minded : ἄλλῃ Il. 15.51. 2 To wish, desire (something): Τρώεσσι βούλετο νίκην Il. 7.21, Il. 13.347, Il. 16.121. Cf. Il. 8.204, Il. 23.682. With infin.: Τρώεσσι κῦδος ὀρέξαι Il. 11.79. Cf. Il. 12.174 = Il. 15.596: Od. 4.275, 353 (βούλοντο here app. an aor.), Od. 15.21, 88. 3 To be willing or ready. With infin.: ἀπὸ λοιγὸν ἀμῦναι Il. 1.67. 4 To prefer: τό κε βουλοίμην Il. 3.41: Od. 11.358 = Od. 20.316. With infin.: αὐτὴν οἴκοι ἔχειν Il. 1.112. Cf. Il. 24.39: Od. 3.143, Od. 9.96, Od. 17.187, 228, Od. 18.364. With ἤ: ἡμῖν Ζεὺς βούλεται ἤ Δαναοῖσι νίκην Il. 17.331. With infin. and ἤ: λαὸν σῶν ἔμμεναι ἢ ἀπολέσθαι Il. 1.117. Cf. Il. 23.594: Od. 3.232, Od. 11.489, Od. 12.350, Od. 16.106, Od. 17.81, 404. Absol.: βούλομαι (I prefer it so, I accept the alternative) Il. 24.226.

braxi/wn.head: βραχίων
braxi/wn.html: βραχίων -ονος, ὁ. The arm Il. 12.389, Il. 13.529, 532, Il. 16.323, 510: Od. 18.69.

bi/bhmi.head: βίβημι
bi/bhmi.html: βίβημι [as βιβάω.] (προ-.) = βιβάω.: μακρὰ βιβάντα (βιβάς) Il. 3.22, Il. 7.213, Il. 15.307, 686, ὕψι βιβάντα Il. 13.371: μακρὰ βιβᾶσα Od. 11.539. Of a ram 450. (For vv. ll. see βιβάω.)

blwqro/s.head: βλωθρός
blwqro/s.html: βλωθρός -ή. App., tall, stately: πίτυς Il. 13.390 = Il. 16.483: ὄγχνην Od. 24.234.

briaro/s.head: βριαρός
briaro/s.html: βριαρός -ή [βρι- as in βρίθω, ὄ-βριμος.] Stout, strong: κόρυθα Il. 11.375. Cf. Il. 16.413, 579, Il. 18.611, Il. 19.381, Il. 20.162, Il. 22.112.

broto/eis.head: βροτόεις
broto/eis.html: βροτόεις -εντος [βρότος.] Gory, blood-stained: ἔναρα Il. 6.480, Il. 8.534, Il. 10.528, 570, Il. 15.347, Il. 17.13, 540, Il. 22.245, ἀνδράγρια Il. 14.509.

bri/qw.head: βρίθω
bri/qw.html: βρίθω (ῑ) [cf. βριθύς.] 3 pl. aor. ἔβρῑσαν Il. 12.346, 359, Il. 17.512. Pple. βρί̄σας, -αντος Il. 17.233: Od. 6.159. 3 sing. pf. βέβρῑθε Il. 16.384. 3 pl. -ᾶσι Od. 15.334. 3 sing. plupf. βεβρί̄θει Od. 16.474. Fem. pple. βεβρῑθυῖα Il. 21.385. (ἐπι-.) 1 To be heavy, loaded or weighed down with something. With dat.: σταφυλῇσιν Il. 18.561. Cf. Od. 16.474, Od. 19.112. With genit.: τυρῶν Od. 9.219. Cf. Od. 15.334. So in pass. With dat.: καρπῷ Il. 8.307. To be oppressed: ὑπὸ λαίλαπι χθών Il. 16.384. 2 To bring one's weight to bear, bear hard: ἰθὺς Δαναῶν βρίσαντες ἔβησαν Il. 17.233. Cf. Il. 12.346 = 359, Il. 17.512. Fig., to be grievous or distressing Il. 21.385. 3 To prevail, achieve one's end: ἐέδνοισιν Od. 6.159.

bruseiai/.head: Βρυσειαί
bruseiai/.html: Βρυσειαί A town in the realm of Menelaus Il. 2.583.

basilhi/s.head: βασιληΐς
basilhi/s.html: βασιληΐς -ΐδος, ἡ [as βασιλήϊος.] Royal, princely Il. 6.193.

bo/sis.head: βόσις
bo/sis.html: βόσις ἡ [βόσκω.] Food : βόσιν ἰχθύσιν Il. 19.268.

barbaro/fwnos.head: βαρβαρόφωνος
barbaro/fwnos.html: βαρβαρόφωνος [βάρβαρος, foreign + φωνή.] App. referring to harshness of speech = ἀγριόφωνος, Il. 2.867.

baqurrei/ths.head: βαθυρρείτης
baqurrei/ths.html: βαθυρρείτης [βαθύς + (σ)ρέω.] With deep, steady flow Il. 23.195.

bru/w.head: βρύω
bru/w.html: βρύω To teem with. With dat.: ἄνθεϊ Il. 17.56.

bro/mos.head: βρόμος
bro/mos.html: βρόμος ὁ [βρέμω.] The roaring (of fire) Il. 14.396.

boa/w.head: βοάω
boa/w.html: βοάω [βοή.] 3 sing. βοάᾳ Il. 14.394. 3 pl. βοόωσι Il. 17.265. Pple. βοόων, -ωντος Il. 2.97, 198, Il. 15.687, 732. Contr. βοῶν Il. 2.224. Dat. sing. masc. aor. pple. βώσαντι Il. 12.337. (ἐπι-, προ-.) 1 To cry aloud, shout: κήρυκες βοόωντες ἐρήτυον Il. 2.97. Cf. Il. 2.198, 224, Il. 8.92, Il. 9.12, Il. 11.15, Il. 12.337, Il. 15.687 = 732, Il. 17.89, 334, 607 (app. for joy on seeing Hector unharmed), Il. 23.847: στὰς ἐβόησα Od. 10.311. Cf. Od. 4.281, Od. 5.400 = Od. 9.473 = Od. 12.181, Od. 6.294, Od. 8.305, Od. 9.403, Od. 24.537. 2 Of things, to roar, resound: θαλάσσης κῦμα Il. 14.394, ἠϊόνες Il. 17.265.

ba/skw.head: βάσκω
ba/skw.html: βάσκω [in form iterative fr. βα-, βαίνω.] (ἐπι-, παρα-.) In imp. with ἴθι, come ! go Il. 2.8, Il. 8.399, Il. 11.186, Il. 15.158, Il. 24.144, 336.

botrudo/n.head: βοτρυδόν
botrudo/n.html: βοτρυδόν (ῡ) [βότρυς.] In clusters Il. 2.89.

blh=tron.head: βλῆτρον
blh=tron.html: βλῆτρον τό [βλη-, βάλλω.] App., a clamp or clincher for fastening lengths together: ξυστὸν κολλητὸν βλήτροισιν Il. 15.678.

bouga/ios.head: βουγάϊος
bouga/ios.html: βουγάϊος [app. a compound of βοῦς, perh. in intensive sense. The second element perh. γαϝ-, γαίω.] Thus, perh., braggart Il. 13.824: Od. 18.79.

baqu/leimos.head: βαθύλειμος
baqu/leimos.html: βαθύλειμος -ον [βαθύς + λειμών.] Having meadows with deep rich grass: Ἄνθειαν Il. 9.151 = 293.

bhlo/s.head: βηλός
bhlo/s.html: βηλός -οῦ, ὁ. A threshold: ῥῖψεν (ῥίπτασκον) ἀπὸ βηλοῦ (i.e. of Olympus) Il. 1.591, Il. 15.23. Cf. Il. 23.202. (There is a tradition that in the first two passages it is a distinct word = οὐρανός.)

bwmo/s.head: βωμός
bwmo/s.html: βωμός -οῦ, ὁ [prob. fr. βα-, βαίνω, something to or on which one mounts.] 1 An altar Il. 1.440, 448, Il. 2.305 (in pl., but app. of a single altar), 310, Il. 4.48 = Il. 24.69, Il. 8.48, 238, 249, Il. 11.808, Il. 23.148: Od. 3.273, Od. 6.162, Od. 8.363, Od. 13.187, Od. 17.210, Od. 22.334, 379. 2 A stand on which the body of a chariot was placed after removal of the wheels. In pl. of a single stand: ἅρματʼ ἃμ βωμοῖσι τίθει Il. 8.441 (app. assimilated to ἅρματα, which is pl. in form only). 3 A pedestal Od. 7.100.

bo/eios.head: βόειος
bo/eios.html: βόειος -η, -ον [βοῦς.] 1 Of an ox: δέρμα Od. 14.24. 2 Made from ox-hide Il. 4.122: Od. 24.228. 3 In fem. βοείη as sb. a A living ox's hide Il. 18.582. An ox-hide lately stripped off Od. 22.364. An ox-hide in process of being dressed Il. 17.389. A dressed ox-hide Il. 11.843: Od. 20.96. A piece of dressed ox-leather Il. 12.296. b A shield of ox-hide Il. 5.452 = Il. 12.425, Il. 22.159.

bou/deion.head: Βούδειον
bou/deion.html: Βούδειον (εὖ ναιόμενον). A town of uncertain site. The original home of Epeigeus Il. 16.572.

bota/nh.head: βοτάνη
bota/nh.html: βοτάνη -ης, ἡ [βόσκω.] 1 Food, fodder Od. 10.411. 2 A feeding-place: ὡς εἴ θʼ ἕσπετο μῆλα ἐκ βοτάνης Il. 13.493.

baqu/rroos.head: βαθύρροος
baqu/rroos.html: βαθύρροος [as βαθυρρείτης.] = βαθυρρείτης. Il. 7.422, Il. 14.311, Il. 21.8: Od. 11.13, Od. 19.434.

bouleu/w.head: βουλεύω
bouleu/w.html: βουλεύω [βουλή.] 1 pl. aor. subj. βουλεύσωμεν Od. 16.234. (μετα-.) 1 To deliberate, consider, take counsel with oneself, concert measures, contrive, plan: ἵνα σφίσι βουλεύῃσθα (in their interests) Il. 9.99. Cf. Il. 2.206 (v.l. βασιλεύῃ): Od. 12.58, Od. 14.491. With infin.: τὸν βούλευσα κατακτάμεν (οὐτάμεναι) (debated whether to ...) Il. 9.458: Od. 9.299. With dependent clause: ὅπως... (how, in what manner) Od. 9.420, Od. 11.229. 2 In dual and pl., to take counsel together: ὣς βουλεύσαντε Il. 1.531, εἰ ἐς μίαν βουλεύσομεν (take counsel to one purpose, lay our plans in common) Il. 2.379. Cf. Od. 13.439, Od. 16.234. With infin. Il. 2.347. 3 With cognate acc.: ὅς κεν ἀρίστην βουλὴν βουλεύσῃ (devise the best counsel) Il. 9.75, βουλὰς βουλεύειν (to take counsel together, hold counsel, concert measures) Il. 10.327. Cf. Il. 10.147, 415, Il. 23.78, Il. 24.652: Od. 6.61. 4 To turn over in one's mind, ponder: ὁδόν Od. 1.444. To meditate, purpose, propose to oneself: φύξιν Il. 10.311 = 398. 5 To plan, contrive, scheme to bring about: ὄλεθρον Il. 14.464. Cf. Od. 5.179 = Od. 10.344, Od. 5.187 = Od. 10.300. To plan, contrive, devise, elaborate: ψεύδεα Od. 14.296. Cf. Od. 5.23 = Od. 24.479, Od. 23.217. In mid.: ἀπάτην βουλεύσατο Il. 2.114 = Il. 9.21.

bouko/los.head: βουκόλος
bouko/los.html: βουκόλος -ου, ὁ [app. for βουπόλος fr. βοῦς + -πολος, conn. with πολεύω. Cf. αἰπόλος.] A herdsman Il. 13.571, Il. 15.587, Il. 23.845: Od. 11.293. Of Philoetius Od. 20.227, Od. 21.83, 189, 193, Od. 22.104, 435, 454 = Od. 23.297, Od. 23.367, Od. 24.359, 363.

boubw/n.head: βουβών
boubw/n.html: βουβών -ῶνος, ὁ. The groin Il. 4.492.

boiwto/s.head: Βοιωτός
boiwto/s.html: Βοιωτός Greek. Βοιωτοί, the Boeotians. Their leaders Il. 2.494, Il. 15.330; Il. 2.510, 526 , Il. 5.710, Il. 13.685, 700.

bre/mw.head: βρέμω
bre/mw.html: βρέμω [cf. L. fremo.] (ἐμ-, ἐπι-.) Of the sea or the wind, to roar Il. 4.425. In mid. Il. 2.210, Il. 14.399.

bruxa/omai.head: †βρυχάομαι
bruxa/omai.html: †βρυχάομαι (ῡ) 3 sing. pf. βέβρῦχε Il. 17.264: Od. 5.412. 3 sing plupf. βεβρύχει Od. 12.242. Pple. βεβρῦχώς Il. 13.393, Il. 16.486. To roar. Of a wounded hero Il. 13.393 = Il. 16.486. Of the sea Il. 17.264: Od. 5.412. Of an echoing rock Od. 12.242.

be/lemnon.head: βέλεμνον
be/lemnon.html: βέλεμνον -ου, τό [as βέλος.] A spear or dart: πικρά Il. 22.206. Of arrows Il. 15.484, 489.

ba/dhn.head: βάδην
ba/dhn.html: βάδην [βα-, βαίνω.] Step by step: ἀπιόντος Il. 13.516.

bro/tos.head: βρότος
bro/tos.html: βρότος -ου, ὁ. Shed blood, gore: αἱματόεντα Il. 7.425, Il. 14.7, Il. 18.345, Il. 23.41: μέλανα Od. 24.189.

bia/zw.head: βιάζω
bia/zw.html: βιάζω [βίη.] 1 To bring one's might to bear upon, bear hard upon, press, use violence against. In mid.: βιάζεταί δε Il. 22.229. Cf. Od. 9.410. In pass., to be pressed or driven: βελέεσσιν Il. 11.576. Cf. Il. 11.589, Il. 15.727 = Il. 16.102. 2 To push one's advantage against, constrain: βιάζετέ με μοῦνον ἐόντα Od. 12.297.

baqu/kolpos.head: βαθύκολπος
baqu/kolpos.html: βαθύκολπος -ον [βαθύς + κόλπος.] Whose robe falls down in a deep fold over the girdle (cf. βαθύζωνος.). Epithet of women Il. 18.122, 339, Il. 24.215.

brome/w.head: βρομέω
brome/w.html: βρομέω [βρόμος.] Of flies, to buzz Il. 16.642.

ba/rdistos.head: βάρδιστος
ba/rdistos.html: βάρδιστος [metathesis of βράδιστος, superl. of βραδύς.] Slowest. Of horses Il. 23.310, 530.

bambai/nw.head: βαμβαίνω
bambai/nw.html: βαμβαίνω An imitative formation, to stammer; or perh. redup. fr. βαίνω, to staggerIl. 10.375.

brih/puos.head: βριήπυος
brih/puos.html: βριήπυος [app. βρι- as in βριαρός + ἠπύω.] Thus, with powerful or loud voice. Epithet of Ares Il. 13.521.

bradu/s.head: βραδύς
bradu/s.html: βραδύς Slow Il. 8.104: Od. 8.330. Absol.: κιχάνει β. ὠκύν Od. 8.329. For superl. See βάρδιστος.

briqosu/nh.head: βριθοσύνη
briqosu/nh.html: βριθοσύνη (ῑ) -ης, ἡ [βριθύς.] Weight, load: ἔβραχεν ἄξων βριθοσύνῃ Il. 5.839, πέσε λίθος εἴσω βριθοσύνῃ (by its weight) Il. 12.460.

bati/eia.head: Βατίεια
bati/eia.html: Βατίεια (αἰπεῖα). A hill in the Trojan plain Il. 2.813. So called by mortals; called by the gods (Il. 2.814) the grave-mound of Myrine.

bohqo/os.head: βοηθόος
bohqo/os.html: βοηθόος [βοή + θέω.] Running to the battle-cry, coming swiftly to the fight Il. 13.477. The epithet transferred from the warrior to his chariot Il. 17.481.

blosuro/s.head: βλοσυρός
blosuro/s.html: βλοσυρός -ή, -όν. App., shaggy Il. 7.212, Il. 15.608.

ble/faron.head: βλέφαρον
ble/faron.html: βλέφαρον τό. Always in dual or pl. The eyelids: οὐχ ὕπνος ἐπὶ βλεφάροισιν ἐφίζανε Il. 10.26. Cf. Il. 10.187, Il. 14.165, Il. 17.438, Il. 19.17, Il. 24.637: δάκρυ βάλεν ἐκ βλεφάροιϊν Od. 17.490. Cf. Od. 1.364, Od. 2.398, Od. 4.114, Od. 5.493, Od. 8.522, Od. 9.389, etc.

bare/w.head: †βαρέω
bare/w.html: †βαρέω [βαρύς.] Pf. pple. βεβαρηώς, -ότος. In this pple., weighed down, overcome Od. 3.139, Od. 19.122.

bole/w.head: †βολέω
bole/w.html: †βολέω [=βάλλω.] Pf. pple. pass. βεβολημένος Il. 9.9: Od. 10.247. 3 pl. plupf. βεβολήατο Il. 9.3. (ἀντι-.) Of grief, to smite: πένθεϊ βεβολήατο (were in the state of having been smitten, were tossed about or agitated) Il. 9.3. Cf. Il. 9.9: Od. 10.247.

boulh/.head: βουλή
boulh/.html: βουλή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 A select council of the most important chiefs (cf. ἀγορή 1) Il. 2.53, 194, 202, Il. 10.195, Il. 12.213: Od. 3.127. 2 The deliberation or discussion in the council: ὅσοι οὐ βουλῆς ἐπάκουσαν Il. 2.143. 3 The place of council Il. 2.84: Od. 6.55. 4 Counsel, concerting of measures, contriving, planning, scheming: οἳ περί ἐστε βουλὴν Δαναῶν (in . . .) Il. 1.258. Cf. Il. 9.54, Il. 10.43, Il. 11.627, Il. 13.728, 741, Il. 16.630: ἐπίφρονι Od. 3.128. Cf. Od. 4.267, Od. 12.211, Od. 13.298, 305, Od. 16.242, 374, 420, Od. 22.230. In pl.: ὅτι οἱ συμφράσσατο βουλάς Il. 1.537. Cf. Il. 1.540, Il. 2.340, Il. 9.374, Il. 15.71, Il. 20.154: Od. 4.462, 677 = Od. 16.412, Od. 11.437, 510. For βουλὴν (βουλὰς) βουλεύειν see βουλεύω 3. 5 A conclusion, a resolve, a course to take: βουλήν, ἣ θεοῖσιν ἐφήνδανεν Il. 7.45. Cf. Il. 2.5 = Il. 10.107 = Il. 14.161, Il. 17.469: Od. 9.318 = 424 = Od. 11.230, Od. 14.337. 6 What one has contrived or planned. In pl.: Θέτιδος ἐξήνυσε βουλάς Il. 8.370. A plan or plot: οὐχ ἡμῖν συνθεύσεται ἥδε γε βουλή Od. 20.245. 7 Counsel given, advice, what one proposes or puts forward: πυκινήν Il. 2.55 = Il. 10.302. Cf. Il. 2.282, Il. 4.323, Il. 7.325 = Il. 9.94, Il. 8.36 = 467, Il. 12.109, Il. 14.102, Il. 18.313, 510: εἴ τινα βουλὴν εἴποι Od. 11.479. Cf. Od. 3.150, Od. 8.506, Od. 10.46, Od. 12.339, Od. 24.52. In pl.: βουλέων μευ ξύνιεν Il. 1.273 Cf. Il. 2.273. 8 One's will, resolve, determination: Διὸς βουλή Il. 1.5. Cf. Il. 2.344, Il. 12.241, Il. 20.15, 20: Od. 1.86, Od. 2.372, Od. 5.30, Od. 11.297, Od. 13.127, Od. 14.328 = Od. 19.297. In pl.: Ζηνὸς βουλέων Il. 12.236. Cf. Il. 13.524, Il. 21.229: Od. 8.82, Od. 11.276, Od. 16.402. 9 One's mind, what one has in view or is doing Od. 2.281, Od. 11.177.

braduth/s.head: βραδυτής
braduth/s.html: βραδυτής -ῆτος, ἡ [βραδύς.] Slowness, want of speed: βραδυτῆτί τε νωχελίῃ τε Il. 19.411.

bio/s.head: βιός
bio/s.html: βιός -οῦ, ὁ. A bow Il. 1.49, Il. 11.125, Il. 10.260, Il. 11.387, Il. 15.468, 472, Il. 24.605: Od. 6.270, Od. 19.577 = Od. 21.75, Od. 21.173, 233, 328, Od. 22.2, 246, Od. 24.170, 177.

baqudi/nhs.head: βαθυδίνης
baqudi/nhs.html: βαθυδίνης -ου [as βαθυδινήεις.] = βαθυδινήεις.: ποταμός Il. 20.73, Il. 21.143, 212, 228, 329: Ὠκεανῷ Od. 10.511.

bh=ssa.head: βῆσσα
bh=ssa.html:
βῆσσα -ης, ἡ. A glen or dell Il. 3.34, Il. 11.87, Il. 14.397, Il. 16.634, 766, Il. 17.283, Il. 18.588, Il. 22.190: Od. 10.210, 252, 275, Od. 19.435.
Βῆσσα A Locrian town Il. 2.532.

baru/s.head: βαρύς
baru/s.html: βαρύς -εῖα, -ύ [cf. βριθύς.] 1 Heavy. Of the hand or arm, heavy, powerful Il. 1.89, 219, Il. 5.81, Il. 11.235 = Il. 17.48, Il. 13.410, Il. 21.590, Il. 23.687: Od. 18.56. 2 Heavy to bear, grievous, dire: ἄτῃ Il. 2.111 = Il. 9.18. Cf. Il. 5.417, Il. 10.71, Il. 20.55: Od. 15.233. Giving misery, stern, dire, grim: κῆρας Il. 21.548. Cf. Od. 7.197. 3 Of a voice, deep (as proceeding from a giant's throat) Od. 9.257. 4 In neut. βαρύ as adv., of groaning, heavily, deeply Il. 1.364 = Il. 18.78, Il. 4.153, Il. 9.16, Il. 16.20, Il. 18.70, 323, Il. 23.60: Od. 8.95 = 534. So in neut. pl. βαρέα Il. 8.334, Il. 13.423, 538 = Il. 14.432: Od. 4.516 = Od. 23.317, Od. 5.420, Od. 10.76.

boeu/s.head: βοεύς
boeu/s.html: βοεύς ὁ [βοῦς.] A strap of ox-leather (used for hoisting a sail): ἕλκον ἱστία βοεῦσιν Od. 2.426 = Od. 15.291.

basileu/w.head: βασιλεύω
basileu/w.html: βασιλεύω [βασιλεύς.] (ἐμ-.) 1 To rule, hold sway, be king, chief or ruler Il. 2.203, Il. 9.616: Od. 1.392, Od. 2.47, Od. 19.179, Od. 22.52, Od. 24.483. 2 To be king or chief of or ruler over. a With genit.: Ἀχαιῶν Od. 1.401. b With dat.: Γιγάντεσσιν Od. 6.59. Cf. Il. 2.206 (v.l. βουλεύῃσι). 3 Of a woman, to enjoy rank as the wife of a βασιλεύς Il. 6.425. With local genit.: πύλου Od. 11.285.

baru/nw.head: βαρύνω
baru/nw.html: βαρύνω [βαρύς.] Aor. pple. pass. βαρυνθείς Il. 20.480. Acc. neut. βαρυνθέν Il. 8.308. To weigh down, oppress: γυῖα βαρύνεται Il. 19.165. Cf. Il. 5.664, Il. 8.308, Il. 20.480: Od. 5.321. Sim.: δόναξ ἐβάρυνε μηρόν (app., made it painful to move) Il. 11.584.

briqu/s.head: βριθύς
briqu/s.html: βριθύς -ύ [cf. βαρύς and βρί̄θω.] Heavy, weighty: ἔγχος Il. 5.746 = Il. 8.390, Il. 16.141 = Il. 19.388, Il. 16.802: Od. 1.100.

blosurw=pis.head: βλοσυρῶπις
blosurw=pis.html: βλοσυρῶπις [βλοσυρός.+ ὦπα.] App., grim-looking: Γοργώ Il. 11.36.

bw=ros.head: Βῶρος-1.
bw=ros.html:
Βῶρος-1. A Maeonian (Μῄων), father of Phaestus-2 Il. 5.44 .
Βῶρος-2. Son of Perieres, husband of Polydora and nominal father of Menesthius-2 Il. 16.177.

bo/skw.head: βόσκω
bo/skw.html: βόσκω 2 sing. fut. βοσκήσεις Od. 17.559. 3 pl. pa. iterative pass. βοσκέσκοντο Od. 12.355. 1 To feed, tend (cattle, etc.) Il. 15.548: Od. 14.102. 2 To feed, nourish, support: γαῖα ἀνθρώπους Od. 11.365. Cf. Od. 9.124, Od. 12.97, Od. 14.325= Od. 19.294. To fill or stuff (one's belly) Od. 17.228, 559, Od. 18.364. 3 In pass., of cattle, etc., to feed, graze: ξύλοχον κάτα βοσκομενάων Il. 5.162. Cf. Il. 16.151, Il. 17.62, Il. 20.223: Od. 4.338 = Od. 17.129, Od. 11.108, Od. 12.128, 355, Od. 14.104, Od. 21.49. Of birds, to feed Il. 15.691.

basileu/s.head: βασιλεύς
basileu/s.html: βασιλεύς -ῆος, ὁ. One in authority, a king, chief, noble. 1 Of men (never of gods), sometimes as a title, sometimes as a descriptive term. Of Agamemnon Il. 1.9, 231, 340, 410, Il. 3.179, Il. 4.402, Il. 7.180, Il. 11.23, 46, 136, 262, 283, Il. 19.256. Of Achilles Il. 1.331, Il. 16.211. Of Nestor Il. 2.54. Of Paris Il. 4.96. Of Priam Il. 5.464, Il. 24.680, 803. Of Proetus Il. 6.163. Of Rhesus Il. 10.435, 494. Of Sarpedon Il. 16.660. Of Menelaus Od. 4.44, 621. Of Alcinous Od. 7.46, 55, 141, Od. 8.157, 257, 469, Od. 13.62. Of Odysseus Od. 16.335, Od. 20.194. Of Antinous and Eurymachus Od. 18.64. Of Antinous Od. 24.179. Of minor heroes and personages Il. 4.338, Il. 13.643, Il. 20.219, Il. 23.631, 849: Od. 4.618 = Od. 15.118, Od. 14.316, 336, Od. 18.85 = 116 = Od. 21.308, Od. 19.287. Joined with ἄναξ Od. 20.194. 2 In various contexts: κρείς σων β. ὅτε χώσεται ἀνδρὶ χέρηϊ Il. 1.80, διοτρεφέων βασιλήων 176, ὅν τινα βασιλῆα κιχείη Il. 2.188, εἷς β. [ἔστω] 205. Cf. Il. 2.86, 98, 196, 214, 247, 250, 277, 445, etc.: μὴ σέ γε βασιλῆα κρονίων ποιήσειεν Od. 1.386, δίκη βασιλήων Od. 4.691. Cf. Od. 1.394, Od. 2.231 = Od. 5.9, Il. 20.480, Od. 4.63, Od. 6.54, Od. 7.49, Od. 8.41, 390, Od. 10.110, Od. 13.205, Od. 14.278, Od. 17.416, Od. 19.109, Od. 20.196, 222, Od. 24.88, 253.

bronth/.head: βροντή
bronth/.html: βροντή -ῆς, ἡ. Thunder Il. 13.796, Il. 21.199: Od. 20.121.

bw/twr.head: βώτωρ
bw/twr.html: βώτωρ -ορος, ὁ. = βοτήρ Il. 12.302: Od. 14.102, Od. 17.200.

boukoli/dhs.head: Βουκολίδης
boukoli/dhs.html: Βουκολίδης Patronymic of Sphelus Il. 15.338.

busso/s.head: βυσσός
busso/s.html: βυσσός -οῦ, ὁ. The depth of the sea Il. 24.80.

bouleuth/s.head: βουλευτής
bouleuth/s.html: βουλευτής ὁ [βουλεύω.] A member of the βουλή, a councillorIl. 6.114.

blemeai/nw.head: βλεμεαίνω
blemeai/nw.html: βλεμεαίνω Of unknown meaning. App., to exult, bear oneself proudly, or the like: σθένεϊ βλεμεαίνων Il. 8.337. Cf. Il. 9.237, Il. 12.42, Il. 17.22, 135, Il. 20.36.

be/los.head: βέλος
be/los.html: βέλος -εος, τό [βάλλω.] Dat. pl. βελέεσσι Il. 5.622, Il. 11.576, 589, Il. 13.511, etc.: Od. 3.280, Od. 5.124, Od. 11.173, 199, Od. 15.411. βέλεσσι Il. 1.42, Il. 13.555, Il. 24.759. βέλεσι Il. 11.657: Od. 16.277. A missile. 1 A spear or dart, but in pl. not necessarily excluding arrows or stones: οὐχ ἅλιον β. ἧκεν Il. 4.498, βελέων ἐρωήν 542. Cf. Il. 5.18, 316, 622, Il. 8.67, 159, etc.: Od. 16.277.–ἐκ βελέων, out of range of missiles: ὕπαγεν Il. 11.163. Cf. Il. 16.122, 668, 678, 781, Il. 18.152. So ὑπὲκ βελέων Il. 4.465, Il. 18.232. Motion not implied: ἐκ βελέων (keeping out of their range) Il. 14.130. 2 An arrow Il. 1.42, 51, 382, Il. 4.99, Il. 5.104, Il. 15.444, etc.: Od. 3.280 = Od. 15.411, Od. 5.124 = Od. 11.173 = 199, Od. 21.138 = 165, Od. 21.148, Od. 22.83, Od. 24.180. 3 A stone Il. 12.159, 458, Il. 14.439, Il. 16.737. Of the rock thrown by the Cyclops Od. 9.495. 4 Of the θρῆνυς thrown by Antinous Od. 17.464. Of the ox's foot thrown by Ktesippus Od. 20.305. 5 Applied to a weapon in gen. Il. 13.289. 6 Metaphorically of the wound inflicted by a missile: ὥς τις β. πέσσῃ Il. 8.513. Of the pains of childbirth Il. 11.269.

bwtia/neira.head: βωτιάνειρα
bwtia/neira.html: βωτιάνειρα ἡ [βω-, βόσκω + -τι- + ἀνήρ.] Feeding men, rich in food: φθιῃ Il. 1.155.

bi/as.head: Βίας-1
bi/as.html:
Βίας-1 Greek. (ποιμὴν λαῶν). Il. 4.296.
Βίας-2 Greek. (ἐΰς). Il. 13.691.
Βίας-3 Trojan. Father of Laogonus-2 and Dardanus-2 Il. 20.460 .

bai/nw.head: βαίνω
bai/nw.html: βαίνω A 3 sing. fut. in mid. form βήσεται Il. 2.339. Aor. ἔβην Il. 24.766: Od. 9.177. βῆν Od. 9.196, Od. 10.60, 169, 407, Od. 12.367. 2 sing. ἔβης Il. 9.107. 3 sing. ἔβη Il. 1.311, 424, Il. 2.47, 187, Il. 3.261, etc.: Od. 1.427, Od. 2.18, 27, 173, Od. 4.701, etc. βῆ Il. 1.34, 44, 439, Il. 2.16, etc.: Od. 1.102, 119, 441, Od. 2.5, 10, etc. 3 dual ἐβήτην Il. 6.40. βήτην Il. 8.115, Il. 12.330, Il. 14.281, 285, etc.: Od. 8.49, Od. 17.200, Od. 22.202, 378. βάτην Il. 1.327, Il. 5.778, Il. 9.182, 192, etc.: Od. 24.361. 1 pl. ἔβημεν Od. 14.241. βῆμεν Od. 3.131, Od. 9.85, 150, Od. 10.56, etc. 3 pl. ἔβησαν Il. 8.343, Il. 11.460, Il. 12.16, Il. 13.332, etc.: Od. 5.107, Od. 24.301. βῆσαν Od. 20.158, Od. 21.188. ἔβαν Il. 1.391, 606, Il. 2.302, Il. 3.113, Il. 7.429, etc.: Od. 1.211, 424, Od. 3.11, 162, 396, etc. βάν Il. 4.209, Il. 10.150, 273, 297, Il. 12.106, etc.: Od. 4.779, Od. 8.56, 109, Od. 15.109, 295, etc. Subj. βήω Il. 6.113. 3 pl. βῶσι Od. 14.86. Opt. βαίην Il. 24.246. Pple. βάς, βάντος Il. 5.239, Il. 6.65, Il. 10.576, Il. 18.532: Od. 2.419, Od. 4.48, 680, Od. 5.56, Od. 8.296, 314, 450, 456, etc. Infin. βήμεναι Il. 17.504: Od. 8.518, Od. 14.327, Od. 19.296. βῆναι Il. 13.459, Il. 14.24. 2 sing. pf. βέβηκας Il. 15.90. 3 sing. βέβηκε Il. 16.69, Il. 23.481. 3 pl. βεβάασι Il. 2.134. 3 sing. plupf. ἐβεβήκει Il. 6.513, Il. 11.296, 446, Il. 13.156, etc. βεβήκει Il. 1.221, Il. 6.313, 495, Il. 16.751, 856, etc.: Od. 1.360, Od. 3.410, Od. 6.11, Od. 8.361, Od. 10.388, etc. 3 pl. βέβασαν Il. 17.286. Pple. βεβαώς Il. 14.477. Acc. sing. masc. βεβαῶτα Od. 5.130. Fem. βεβῶσα Od. 20.14. Infin. βεβάμεν Il. 17.359, 510. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐβήσετο Il. 14.229: Od. 7.135, Od. 13.63, 75, Od. 15.284. βήσετο Il. 3.262, 312, Il. 5.745, Il. 8.389: Od. 3.481. B 3 sing. aor. βῆσε Il. 1.310, Il. 5.164, Il. 16.810. 1 pl. ἐβήσαμεν Od. 11.4. βήσαμεν Il. 11.756. 3 pl. βῆσαν Il. 1.438. 1 pl. subj. βήσομεν Il. 1.144. (ἀμφι-, ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, εἰσ-, εἰσανα-, ἐκ-, ἐκδια-, ἐμ-, ἐξανα-, ἐξαπο-, ἐπεμ-, ἐπι-, ἐσκατα-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, ὑπερ-, ὑπερκατα-.) I Intrans. in all forms except those under (B). 1 To go, go one's way, take one's way: παρὰ θῖνα θαλάσσης Il. 1.34. Cf. Il. 1.44, 311, 424, Il. 2.16, 47, Il. 4.443, 495, etc.: οἶκόνδε Od. 1.424. Cf. Od. 1.102, 119, 427, Od. 2.18, 406, Od. 3.131, Od. 9.196, etc. Of something inanimate: ἰκμὰς ἔβη (i.e. finds its way inwards, making way for the unguent) Il. 17.392. 2 Of immaterial things, to go, pass. εὐχωλαί Il. 8.229. Cf. Il. 2.339. So of time: ἐννέα βεβάασιν ἐνιαυτοί (have passed) Il. 2.134. 3 a In pf. of the state or condition of going: ἔχων εὔληρα βέβηκε (is going, i.e. is driving the chariot) Il. 23.481: περὶ τρόπιος βεβαῶτα (bestriding it and being carried along with it) Od. 5.130. b In plupf., of being in the act or attitude of going: Οὔλυμπόνδε βεβήκει (was in motion to go, i.e. started or set out to go, took her way) Il. 1.221. Cf. Il. 6.313, 495, Il. 11.446, Il. 16.751, 856 = Il. 22.362, Il. 16.864, Il. 17.706, Il. 22.21, Il. 23.391: Od. 1.360 = Od. 21.354, Od. 8.361, Od. 10.388, Od. 13.164, Od. 15.464, Od. 17.26, 61, Od. 18.185 = Od. 19.503 = Od. 22.433, Od. 19.47 = Od. 20.144, Od. 23.292. But in strict plupf. sense: Ἄϊδόσδε βεβήκει Od. 3.410 = Od. 6.11. Without complementary words, strode along Il. 6.513, Il. 11.296, Il. 13.156, Il. 20.161. 4 To start or set out to go, run, etc.: βῆ θέειν Il. 2.183, βῆ ἰέναι Il. 4.199. Cf. Il. 5.167, Il. 6.296, Il. 13.27, Il. 20.32, Il. 23.229, etc.: Od. 1.441, Od. 2.298, Od. 4.779, Od. 14.87, 501, etc. 5 To move oneself into a specified position, get on to, into, out of, something: ἐς ἅρματα Il. 5.239, ἐς ἀσαμίνθους Il. 10.576. Cf. Il. 5.364, 745, Il. 6.65, Il. 17.504, Il. 18.532, Il. 23.132, etc.: ἐξ ἀσαμίνθου Od. 3.468. Cf. Od. 3.481, 492, Od. 4.48, Od. 12.229, Od. 21.51, etc. So with acc.: βήσετο δίφρον (mounted it) Il. 3.262 = 312. Without the acc.: ἄπιθεν βῆ Ἀχιλλεύς (mounted after him) Il. 19.397. Of going (on board a ship): ἐπὶ νηὸς ἔβαινεν Il. 13.665. Cf. Od. 2.416, Od. 8.501, Od. 9.177, Od. 11.534, Od. 15.284, 547. Of disembarking (from a ship): ἐκ νηὸς βῆ Il. 1.439. Cf. Od. 3.12, Od. 13.116. Sim.: ἐπʼ ἠπείρου βῆμεν Od. 9.85 = Od. 10.56. 6 With adverbs and prepositions. a With ἀμφί as prep., to bestride: ἀμφʼ ἑνὶ δούρατι βαῖνεν Od. 5.371. So, to bestride and protect (a fallen friend) (cf. ἀμφιβαίνω 4, περιβαίνω): ἀμφʼ αὐτῷ βαῖνεν Il. 5.299. Cf. Il. 14.477, Il. 17.4, 359, 510. Sim. with περί: περὶ πατρόκλῳ βαῖνεν Il. 17.6. Cf. Il. 17.4, 137: Od. 20.14. Of bestriding the body of a foe with a view to dragging it off: Τρῶες περὶ Πατρόκλῳ βέβασαν Il. 17.286. (For the time indicated in these cases by the pf. and plupf. cf. (3).) b With ἀνά. α To mount a chariot, etc.: ἀνʼ ἔβη Πρίαμος Il. 3.261. Cf. Il. 3.311, Il. 17.541: Od. 6.253. Sim. with παρά, to mount a chariot(and stand) beside another: πὰρ μαχάων βαινέτω (βαῖνεν) Il. 11.513, 518. Also with παρά as prep.: πὰρ δέ οἱ Ἶρις ἔβαινεν Il. 5.365. β To go on board a ship: ἀνʼ αὐτοὶ βάντες (βαίνομεν) Od. 2.419 = Od. 4.579, Od. 11.5. Cf. Od. 13.75. c With ἐκ. α To dismount from a chariot: ἐκ δʼ ἔβαν αὐτοί Il. 3.113. β To disembark from a ship: ἐξ αὐτοὶ βαῖνον Il. 1.437. Cf. Od. 3.11,Od. 4.785, Od. 9.150 = 547 = Od. 12.6, Od. 15.499. d With μετά of crossing an indicated line: μετὰ δʼ ἄστρα βεβήκει (had crossed the meridian) Od. 12.312, Od. 14.483. e For περί, παρά see a b. 7 To come: τίπτε βέβηκας; (hast thou come) Il. 15.90, πόλις ἐπὶ πᾶσα βέβηκε (has come to encounter us) Il. 16.69. II Trans. in forms (B). To cause to take a specified position: ἄν Χρυσηΐδα βήσομεν (let us put her on board) Il. 1.144, ἐς ἑκατόμβην βῆσεν (put it on board) 310, ἐξ ἑκατόμβην βῆσαν (landed it) 438, τοὺς ἐξ ἵππων βῆσεν (thrust or knocked off) Il. 5.164, βήσαμεν ἵππους (brought to a stand, stopped) Il. 11.756, φῶτας βῆσεν ἀφʼ ἵππων Il. 16.810: ἐν τὰ μῆλα ἐβήσαμεν (put them on board) Od. 11.4.

be/lteros.head: βέλτερος
be/lteros.html: βέλτερος [comp. fr. βολ-, βόλομαι]. Better. In neut. βέλτερον with or without copula, it is (would be) better: β. ὃς προφύγῃ κακόν Il. 14.81 ([κείνῳ] ὅς = εἴ τις). With complementary infin.: β. ἀπολέσθαι Il. 15.511. Cf. Il. 15.197, Il. 18.302, Il. 21.485, Il. 22.129. With dat. and infin.: πτωχῷ β. ἐστι δαῖτα πτωχεύειν Od. 17.18. With εἰ: β., εἰ καὐτὴ πόσιν εὗρεν ἄλλοθεν Od. 6.282.

ba/zw.head: βάζω
ba/zw.html: βάζω 3 sing. pf. pass. βέβακται Od. 8.408. 1 To speak Od. 3.127, Od. 11.511, Od. 18.168. 2 To say, speak, utter: ταῦτα Il. 4.355, ἄρτια Il. 14.92: ἔπος εἴ τι βέβακται δεινόν Od. 8.408. Cf. Od. 4.32, 206, 837 = Od. 11.464, Od. 8.240, Od. 14.127, 157, Od. 17.461, Od. 18.332 = 392. 3 With double acc. of thing said and person addressed: ταῦτά μʼ ἐβάζετε Il. 16.207. Cf. Il. 9.58.

ba/tos.head: βάτος
ba/tos.html: βάτος -ου. In pl., the prickles of some kind of prickly shrub or plant: βάτων ἕνεκα Od. 24.230.

ba/ptw.head: βάπτω
ba/ptw.html: βάπτω To plunge (into water): πέλεκυν Od. 9.392.

bioth/.head: βιοτή
bioth/.html: βιοτή ἡ [βίος.] =βίος. Od. 4.565.

blhxh/.head: βληχή
blhxh/.html: βληχή ἡ. A bleating: οἰῶν Od. 12.266.

bouluto/nde.head: βουλυτόνδε
bouluto/nde.html: βουλυτόνδε (ῡ) [βοῦς + λύω + -δε 1. To the time for unyoking oxen.] To or towards early afternoon: Ἠέλιος μετενίσετο β. Il. 16.779: = Od. 9.58. (The time specified is fixed for Il. 16.779, and is admissible for Od. 9.58. The reference seems to be to a custom of stopping ploughing at or soon after mid-day.)

bu/blinos.head: βύβλινος
bu/blinos.html: βύβλινος [adj. fr. βύβλος, the Egyptian papyrus.] Made of the fibrous coat of the papyrus Od. 21.391.

brw/mh.head: βρώμη
brw/mh.html: βρώμη -ης, ἡ [βι-βρώσκω.] 1 Food Od. 10.379, 460 = Od. 12.23, Od. 12.302. 2 The partaking of food: μνησόμεθα βρώμης Od. 10.177.

bi/os.head: βίος
bi/os.html: βίος -ου, ὁ [βιϝ-.] One's life, course of life, manner of living: ζώεις ἀγαθὸν βίον Od. 15.491. Cf. Od. 18.254 = Od. 19.127.

bw=los.head: βῶλος
bw=los.html: βῶλος A clod, the clods, of earth Od. 4.374.

bow/ths.head: βοώτης
bow/ths.html:
βοώτης ὁ [ploughman, waggoner, fr. βοῦς.] The constellation the Waggoner, containing the star Arcturus Od. 5.272.
Βοώτης (ὀψὲ δύων). See Lexicon.

bussodomeu/w.head: βυσσοδομεύω
bussodomeu/w.html: βυσσοδομεύω [app. fr. βυσσός + δόμος, to construct in the interior of the house, away from public view.] To plan or ponder secretly Od. 4.676, Od. 8.273, Od. 9.316, Od. 17.66, 465 = 491 = Od. 20.184.

bro/teos.head: βρότεος
bro/teos.html: βρότεος -ον [βροτός.] Mortal, human Od. 19.545.

bwstre/w.head: βωστρέω
bwstre/w.html: βωστρέω [Βωστής = Βοηστής, agent-noun fr. βοάω.] To call to for aid: κράταιϊν Od. 12.124.

basi/leia.head: βασίλεια
basi/leia.html: βασίλεια -ης, ἡ [βασιλεύς.] 1 The wife of a βασιλεύς. Of Penelope Od. 4.697, 770, Od. 16.332, 337, Od. 17.370 = 468 = Od. 18.351 = Od. 21.275, Od. 17.513, 583, Od. 18.314, Od. 23.149. Of Arete Od. 7.241, Od. 11.345, Od. 13.59. 2 The daughter of a βασιλεύς. Of Nausicaa Od. 6.115. 3 β. γυναικῶν, the peerless one among womenOd. 11.258.

bohtu/s.head: βοητύς
bohtu/s.html: βοητύς ἡ [βοάω.] Noise, disturbance Od. 1.369.

bro/xos.head: βρόχος
bro/xos.html: βρόχος ὁ. A noose Od. 11.278, Od. 22.472.

ba/lanos.head: βάλανος
ba/lanos.html: βάλανος ἡ. The fruit of the φηγός Od. 10.242, Od. 13.409.

bu/w.head: †βύω
bu/w.html: †βύω Acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. pass. βεβυσμένον To stuff full of. With genit.: τάλαρον νήματος Od. 4.134.

bolh/.head: βολή
bolh/.html: βολή -ῆς, ἡ [βάλλω.] 1 A blow with a missile Od. 17.283, Od. 24.161. 2 A turn or glance (of the eyes) Od. 4.150.

bou/botos.head: βούβοτος
bou/botos.html: βούβοτος -ον [βοῦς + βόσκω.] Grazed by cattle. Of Ithaca Od. 13.246.

bhta/rmwn.head: βητάρμων
bhta/rmwn.html: βητάρμων -ονος, ὁ [app. βη-, βαίνω + ἁρμ-, ἁρμόζω. One who goes in measure.] A dancer Od. 8.250, 383.

basta/zw.head: βαστάζω
basta/zw.html: βαστάζω 1 To raise. Of pushing uphill Od. 11.594. 2 To take into the hands, handle: τόξον Od. 21.405.

bu/kths.head: βύκτης
bu/kths.html: βύκτης Prob., roaring, blustering Od. 10.20.

bi/aios.head: βίαιος
bi/aios.html: βίαιος [βίη.] Forceful, violent: ἔργα Od. 2.236.

bohqoi/dhs.head: Βοηθοΐδης
bohqoi/dhs.html: Βοηθοΐδης Patronymic of Eteoneus Od. 4.31, Od. 15.95, 140 .

both/r.head: βοτήρ
both/r.html: βοτήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [βόσκω.] (Cf. βώτωρ.) A herdsman: ἀγροὺς ἐπιείσομαι ἠδὲ βοτῆρας Od. 15.504.
